usage: deskops drawer remove [-h] [--root ROOT] [--force] selector

positional arguments:
  selector     Drawer file selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename,
               stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root
  --force      Remove even when a task in desk/tasks/ records the entry in
               from_drawer.
